scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.clean:ports: killall -9 tsx node 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -ti :3001 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -ti :3000 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -ti :4173 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; echo '✓ Ports cleaned'; sleep 2
scripts.deploy: npm run build:all && npm run start:prod
scripts.pm2:start: npm run build:all && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
